text:

QUEST BRIEFING
Three Miles From the Coast
THE LIGHTHOUSE THAT WALKED
WHY THIS MATTERS
REQUESTED BY
Keeper Grandmother Pell
WHY YOUR GUILD ACCEPTS
Without the light, refugee ships are grounding in the black fog.
OBJECTIVE
Follow the tower's stone footprints, rescue its keepers and remove the creature steering it.
STORY THREAD · The moving foundation is an abandoned Crownless navigation beast seeking the seventh bell.
BEFORE DEPARTURE
1 / 2
Grandmother Pell
“My lighthouse walked inland with me still inside. I would like it returned before the stairs learn to run.”

text:

QUEST BRIEFING
Dead Letter Office
LETTERS FROM A SUNKEN SHIP
WHY THIS MATTERS
REQUESTED BY
Postmistress Yara Quill
WHY YOUR GUILD ACCEPTS
Recipients vanish after opening the letters, leaving only seawater and an erased signature.
OBJECTIVE
Trace the impossible postmark, descend at low tide and release the courier from his final route.
STORY THREAD · One undelivered letter was written by Nhal Veyr before history forgot his name.
BEFORE DEPARTURE
1 / 2
Postmistress Yara Quill
“The courier drowned eighty years ago and has never missed a delivery. Unfortunately, the recipients started disappearing this week.”
